senses.gloss: (denom. of next w.) to place straps close together so as to form a boardlike surface. Part. pass. מְלֻוָּוח, pl. מְלֻוָּוחִין.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 8:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 6</cite> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 18:5">Kel. XVIII, 5</cite> reads <he>מְרֻוָּוחִים</he>, v. <cite ref="T00343"><he>רָוַח</he></cite>).
